name: FounderNexus
revenue_floor: Venture-scale; stages mapped as $0–2M ARR (pre-seed/seed) through $50M+ ARR / Exit. Pre-approval: 3+ years as a venture-scale founder or meaningful VC round already raised; experience navigating a VC or angel raise; building or seeking to build a venture-scale company.
other_requirements: Apply → pre-approval → 1–2 free guest sessions → peer evaluation → invitation to matching stage room. VC-fund referrals receive expedited pre-approval.
time_commitment: Monthly stage sessions plus Nexus Partner 1:1; cadence otherwise not quantified on homepage
geography: Online plus in-person (Seattle, San Francisco, London named on Luma)
best_for: Venture-scale founders who want stage-pure peer rooms around live decisions from pre-seed through exit.
not_for: Lifestyle businesses, sub-$1M ARR services firms, or founders who want a paid facilitator-led CEO forum.

name: Vistage
revenue_floor: Chief Executive program: $5M+ revenue / typically 20+ employees. Small Business program: $1–4M revenue.
other_requirements: CEO/owner peer groups of non-competing members; Chair-led. Qualify via form.
time_commitment: Monthly peer group meetings plus monthly 1:1 with Chair; speakers and events
best_for: CEOs and owners who want a Chair-facilitated confidential peer group with coaching, across a wide range of company sizes.
not_for: Founders who need a venture-scale-only room or who reject paid facilitators.

name: YPO
group_size: Chapter forums (exact size varies; not a single published number)
revenue_floor: USD 16M+ sales (or agency USD 13M / financial institution USD 330M AUM / enterprise value USD 27M), plus 50 FTEs or 15+ FTEs with USD 2.75M payroll.
other_requirements: Under age 45 at join (exceptions on apply form for women to 54 and Black CEOs); top operational leader with full P&L and hire/fire authority.
annual_cost: USD 4,790 one-time initiation + USD 4,790 annual global dues; local chapter dues extra and unpublished
time_commitment: Chapter forum and events; global events (EDGE, GBS) optional
best_for: Chief executives who clear a high revenue and headcount bar and want a large global leadership community with local chapters.
not_for: Early-stage or Series A founders below the revenue/headcount bar, or founders who age out of the primary membership path.

name: Entrepreneurs' Organization (EO)
group_size: Forum groups (chapter-based; size not a single published global number)
revenue_floor: US$1M+ revenue business. Venture-backed exception: US$2M private or US$5M public raise plus 10 employees, with 3 years to hit $1M.
other_requirements: Founder, owner, or controlling shareholder. Accelerator on-ramp for US$250k–$999k revenue.
annual_cost: Global dues published as US$2,470 (apply page) vs US$2,630 (chapter pages) + US$3,500 one-time initiation; chapter dues extra/unpublished. Accelerator US$1,750/yr.
time_commitment: Chapter Forum plus events; Global Leadership Conference optional
geography: Global chapters (~226 chapters / 66 countries per homepage stats as of 2026-09-14)
best_for: Founder-owners at roughly $1M+ revenue who want a chapter Forum and a large global entrepreneur network.
not_for: Founders who need venture-scale-only rooms or who reject chapter-based membership with local dues.

name: Hampton
revenue_floor: $3M+ revenue OR $3M+ funding OR $10M+ prior exit; active founders/CEOs of digital or tech-enabled companies
other_requirements: Apply-gated; ~2% accepted (site claim); Core placement ~90 days; 18 chapter cities
time_commitment: Monthly in-person Core group (Aug/Dec off) plus chapter events
best_for: Active tech or digital founders who clear the $3M revenue/funding bar and want a monthly in-person moderated peer group in their city.
not_for: Pre-seed founders below the bar, fully remote founders outside chapter cities, or anyone who wants a published price before applying.

name: Pavilion (formerly Revenue Collective)
group_size: Scale: 10 leaders; broader community 10,000+ (not a single forum size)
revenue_floor: Gold: built for CXOs at 100M+ ARR (tier threshold, not a general membership floor). Associate/Executive have role floors, not revenue floors.
other_requirements: Executive: VPs+ at B2B tech in GTM. Associate: managers and directors. Scale: invitation-only for GTM VPs and C-level. Give-to-get; no pitching.
annual_cost: Associate $1,375; Executive $2,700 (as listed on join form; may vary by seniority/location). Gold and Scale: Not published.
time_commitment: Scale: two hours a month. Broader membership: chapter events and virtual events; no mandatory hours published
best_for: In-seat B2B GTM operators who want Slack, chapters, operator education, and optionally an invite-only Scale forum.
not_for: Individual contributors, early-career non-leaders, or anyone looking to pitch inside the community.

name: Chief
group_size: Core (Jan 2026): C-Suite & Executive Leader 10–12; Builder & Navigator 15–20
revenue_floor: Builders path only: $2M+ annual revenue or venture funding (or past CXO/VP+ at credentialed companies).
other_requirements: Designed for 15+ years leadership experience. Categories: C-Suite, Senior Leaders & Executives, Builders. Criteria effective 10/2025. Not for early career or soliciting business.
annual_cost: Chief Membership $5,900/year + $500 new member fee; Chief Signature $9,800/year (official Membership Experience PDF).
time_commitment: Core: 6 × 90-minute meetings per year (~every two months), plus optional programming; or 4 × 1-hour coaching sessions/year
geography: US Clubhouses (NYC, SF, Chicago, DC) plus virtual and national events
best_for: Senior women leaders seeking Guide-led Core peer advisory, coaching, and executive programming.
not_for: Early-career professionals or anyone joining primarily to solicit business.

name: TIGER 21
revenue_floor: Not a revenue floor — verifiable investable assets or qualifying net worth of at least $20M USD.
other_requirements: Invitation only. Vetted via 5Cs: Character, Contribution, Capacity, Conditions, Capital. Capital alone does not guarantee invitation.
annual_cost: North America: USD 34,000 annual dues + USD 5,000 initiation (effective Apr 1, 2026). Other regions published on pricing policy page.
time_commitment: Monthly day-long meetings 11 times per year
geography: Global — 54 cities, 162 Groups (per About page as of verification)
best_for: UHNW wealth creators who want a Chair-facilitated personal board on investments, family, and legacy.
not_for: Operators below the $20M capital bar, or founders seeking a venture-stage peer room rather than a UHNW wealth network.

name: Founders Network
revenue_floor: No single floor; tiers by experience — Launch (pre-revenue–$10K / self-funded–$100K raised); Scale ($10K–$1M / $100K–$3M raised); Lead ($1M+ / $3M+ raised).
other_requirements: Full-time tech startup founder (no service firms); invite-only with membership committee approval; no selling/pitching.
annual_cost: Launch $75/mo; Scale $134/mo; Lead $249/mo (annual commitments). Lifetime plan amount Not published.
time_commitment: Flexible; 100+ events/year available; Lead includes monthly peer roundtables
geography: Global chapters including SF, Silicon Valley, LA, Seattle, Vancouver, NYC, London
best_for: Full-time tech startup founders who want a vetted peer community and stage-tiered mentoring without giving equity.
not_for: Service-firm operators, non-founders, or people looking to sell inside the network.

name: On Deck / ODF (On Deck Fellowship)
other_requirements: Great fit: track record of shipping; committed (or soon) to starting a company. Not a fit: past pre-seed/PMF, already have a full team, primary customers outside US. Must attend full SF sprint. Non-dilutive.
time_commitment: Required: five business days in San Francisco; ongoing community optional
geography: Onboarding in San Francisco; applicants worldwide
best_for: Pre-seed builders committing to start a company who want an SF onboarding week plus lifetime fellow network without giving equity.
not_for: Founders past pre-seed/PMF, or builders whose primary market will stay outside the US.

name: South Park Commons
group_size: ~175 active members across hubs; peer accountability group sizes Not published
revenue_floor: None stated; focused on -1 to 0 ideation / pre-funding exploration
other_requirements: Expected to be located in SF, NYC, or Bangalore and come into SPC throughout the week; generally full-time; selective application + interview.
annual_cost: No membership fee or dues (Member Residency). Founder Fellowship is separate: $400,000 for 7% SAFE + $600,000 guaranteed in next venture round.
time_commitment: Member Residency up to 6 months; show up in space throughout the week
geography: San Francisco, New York City, Bengaluru
best_for: Technical builders in -1 to 0 who want a talent-dense in-person community before or at the start of a venture-scale company.
not_for: Founders who need a classic confidential CEO peer board, or remote-only members who cannot commit presence in a hub city.

name: Alliance of Chief Executives
revenue_floor: Not published as a numeric floor; membership is fit-based, not balance-sheet gated
other_requirements: Qualified leadership position (CEO / senior leaders); personal fit interview; confidentiality and no-selling principles
annual_cost: $750 one-time enrollment + $11,000 annual dues (monthly/quarterly options). Charged only after first private-group meeting confirms fit.
time_commitment: About 40 hours/year on Alliance participation (site claim); private group meetings plus roundtables/dinners
geography: San Francisco Bay Area / Northern California / Silicon Valley
best_for: Bay Area CEOs who want confidential, facilitated strategic peer forums with industry-diverse operators.
not_for: Pre-revenue founders seeking a startup-only room, or anyone unwilling to invest significant annual time.

name: Foundations
other_requirements: Invite-only application; Member acceptance requires strong track record of building/scaling startups; FIR path for earlier founders; Seattle or SF/Bay based options
time_commitment: FIR: 6-month residency with space as full-time office; Members: visit as third space up to a couple times/week plus weekly events
geography: Seattle (Capitol Hill) and San Francisco (South FiDi)
best_for: Seattle technical founders who want an invite-only in-person community, space, mentors, and peer accountability around early company building.
not_for: Operators seeking a classic confidential CEO peer board with published dues and a fixed monthly half-day forum.

name: Foundwell Founder Circles
revenue_floor: Not published; Circles for startup CEOs who have raised some capital (Seed to Series B); also earlier-stage cohorts without raise
other_requirements: Vetted for fit; startup CEOs; confidential (no recordings/summaries)
time_commitment: Typically every other week for 75 minutes
geography: In-person New York City and Miami; virtual Circles elsewhere
best_for: Seed to Series B startup CEOs who want a small, confidential founder circle focused on honest peer support.
not_for: Non-founder executives or lifestyle business owners seeking a classic SMB CEO board with published pricing.

name: Speakeasy Mastermind (Los Angeles)
revenue_floor: Must meet at least one: >$1M net revenue (gross minus direct COGS); OR owner net income ≥ $250K; OR senior executive at $10M+ company; OR recent exit that met above
other_requirements: Invitation-only after application + fit call; attend a meeting before finalizing; confidentiality code of conduct
annual_cost: $5,995/year (includes monthly meetups, private app, national referrals, digital resources, event discounts, annual summit). City Founders Rate Not published.
time_commitment: One monthly local ~3-hour meetup; optional annual summit
geography: Los Angeles chapter; drop-in at other Speakeasy city chapters
best_for: Established LA entrepreneurs who want a high-bar monthly in-person mastermind plus multi-city network access.
not_for: Pre-revenue or sub-threshold founders, or people seeking a venture-only peer room.

name: The Founders Forum
revenue_floor: None stated; founders at every stage welcome
other_requirements: Current or past founder who built a business from the ground up; must love Jesus (Christ-centered fellowship); Austin-based
time_commitment: Weekly in-person gatherings alternating Bee Cave and Downtown Austin
best_for: Austin founders who want weekly in-person peer support integrating business, leadership, faith, and family — without dues.
not_for: Founders seeking a secular or venture-only peer board, or remote-only participation.
